prompt: Which skills do I need to fly a Gila?

result.text:
Skills required to use **Gila**:

  • Caldari Cruiser II
  • Gallente Cruiser II

Note: also requires the parent skill chain (e.g. Spaceship Command V for capitals).

Full prerequisite chain:
  • Caldari Destroyer III
  • Caldari Frigate III
  • Gallente Destroyer III
  • Gallente Frigate III
  • Spaceship Command II
